concepts.label: Accepted Paper
concepts.description: Accepted paper to become part of proceedings. Note that camera-ready paper is not considered as 'accepted paper', as it was accepted in a different form!

concepts.label: Criterion
concepts.description: Criteria are used to evaluate a paper.

concepts.label: ExternalReviewer
concepts.description: An External Reviewer is a person that has been assigned to review a paper for another Reviewer, but is not themselves a Reviewer.

concepts.label: Meta-Reviewer
concepts.description: A special type of Reviewer.  There can be any number of Reviewers for a given paper, but only one Meta-Reviewer.  The Meta-Reviewer can go over all the reviews submitted for the paper and submit their own review.  Questions for the Meta-Reviewer can be different from those for a normal Reviewer. ...

concepts.label: PaperQuestion
concepts.description: Questions must be asked to the author that submits a paper.

concepts.label: Planed Paper
concepts.description: Paper planned in the program of the conference

concepts.label: ProgramCommitteeMember
concepts.description: The Program Committee consists of all members of the conference except for Authors who are not also Reviewers.

concepts.label: ReviewQuestion
concepts.description: Questions must be asked to the reviewer that submits a review.

concepts.label: Reviewing results event
concepts.description: Results of the reviewing procedures, accessable to authors

concepts.label: Session
concepts.description: Sessions of the conference. Each session is associated to one of the previously defined slots.

concepts.label: Slot
concepts.description: A “slot of the conference” is a period of a given day that hosts one or several sessions.

concepts.label: end date of full paper submission
start date of full paper submission
